units.source_text: 人，能从各式芳香中悟出种种真理，我不认为这仅仅是美好的象征之歌。

en.t: People can perceive many kinds of truth from all sorts of fragrances, and I do not think this is merely a beautiful symbolic song.

units.source_text: 犹如众香之国的圣者把香当作食粮一样，莱蒙特所说的灵魂之国的人，则把色当作心灵的食粮。

en.t: Just as the saints in the land of many fragrances take scent as their food, the people of the realm of the soul that Lemont speaks of take color as nourishment for the spirit.
